decisions.reason: The offshore vessel management service is close to the firm's maritime management capabilities, has already survived beyond launch with a dedicated business unit, and fits the firm's expansion into broader and more sustainable shipping services.

Crew and corporate travel management builds very directly on the firm's existing crew, administration and travel strengths, so management can readily learn from demand and integrate it into the core service bundle.

An online vessel information portal is still closely tied to the firm's vessel-management knowledge and customer relationships, though the digital product element raises some execution risk in a sector with weaker in-house R&D.

The mobile vessel performance app draws on the firm's operational knowledge of vessels, but its software and analytics character makes it somewhat harder to absorb and refine than the service-led offerings, so the drop risk is higher but still below the threshold for discontinuation.
